title: Open indexed files from an extracted dataset folder
changes: Allow a reader to select an extracted folder once and open matching resource paths in the existing file inspector, with explicit path-only matching and disconnect controls.
Keep the folder chooser disabled until initialization and recover any selection that arrived before its listener was registered.
validation: Synthetic units rom-data-viewer-directory-ready-id2lnqf6 and rom-data-viewer-directory-early-2ynmp1y9 checked real folder selection, nested paths, ambiguous names, file replacement, disconnect and early selection. Regression unit rom-data-viewer-directory-regression-n61r4p2c checked text and hexadecimal search.

Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-directory-eur-ready-1p18b2r4 matched all 150 indexed resources and checked a JSON tree and a large file in Linux Chrome. Initial is0fbozr timed out on an early selection; diagnostic 8o8n0vt6 confirmed the race before the fix.
limitations: Matching uses relative paths and does not recheck selected contents against the generated manifest. Windows and physical browser interaction remain unverified.
